decisions.statement: A call here is worked out from the pages rather than spelled as words.
A level renamed on its page is a call renamed here with no edit.
A script that runs on a machine reaches its calls here rather than spelling one.
Nothing here reads the index or the disk.
No call here is run from here.
A level put between two named here is left whole in the call until this names it.

definition: the calls a provisioning script makes, composed from the pages naming their levels
